title: Survey Column
description: A freestanding tapered 18 m limestone column with fluted drums, a weathered plinth, and an overhanging capital.

review.notes: Round 3 (final, rebuilt). Fixed: the capital now has a neck ring, echinus and abacus, the flutes are cut in, drum heights vary, and the proportions read as an 18 m column. Not fixed: (1) the cracks are dark diagonal streaks painted on the flutes (closeup_upper, hero.jpg), with no depth or chipped edges; there are still no modeled chips or broken arrises. (2) At every drum joint the flute edges zigzag and misalign, so each seam reads as a wavy scalloped line (closeup_upper, closeup_base). (3) The base torus is soft and lumpy, and the pebbles sit in an evenly spaced ring around it. Fix: modeled cracks and chipped flute edges, crisp aligned flutes at the drum joints, a crisp base profile, and irregular debris with dirt at the foot.
